entities.summary: Lozi Kingdom, a political institution in Zambia during Pre-Colonial Kingdoms and Chiefdoms (1600–1900). Grew from Lozi Kingdom Barotseland and Ingombe Ilede and Long-Distance Trade. Led to the emergence of Bemba Kingdom and Eastern Lunda Kingdom.
